board: M5Stack Unit Angle (SKU U005), Grove HY2.0-4P: GND, 5V, NC (yellow), AO (white)
reason: Check PASSED on ESP32 and Pico (run 1). Modelled from M5Stack's schematic/output diagram (10k series resistor + 10k pot from 5V, wiper = output, Uo = 5V*Rp/(Rp+10k), spec 0-2500 mV) and the docs PinMap; driver inverts that formula to knob position. Note: one M5Stack schematic image shows R1 = 4.7k (max 3.4 V); the spec and formula diagram both give 10k, documented as a gotcha.
